description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

HII’s Mission Technologies division is seeking an Early Career Software Engineer to help develop and maintain software applications for national broadband initiatives, data analytics platforms, and telecommunications systems. The role supports reliable, secure, and scalable solutions and includes software development, maintenance, and collaboration with experienced engineers and cross-functional teams.
Early Career Software Engineer supporting national telecommunications software design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance

Responsibilities:
• Assist in the design, development, testing, and deployment of software solutions that support national telecommunications mission objectives
• Work with senior engineers and product teams to translate requirements into technical tasks
• Learn and apply secure coding practices and support compliance with cybersecurity standards
• Support maintenance activities, bug fixes, and performance enhancements for existing applications
• Contribute to basic documentation and participate in team knowledge‑sharing activities

Requirements:
• 0 years experience with Bachelors in related field with previous engineering internship experience
• 2 years relevant experience with Bachelors in related field; 0 years experience with Masters in related field
• Foundational knowledge or coursework in at least one of the following: Python, MATLAB, Rust, Unreal Engine, or Azure Cloud/Windows desktop environments
• Basic understanding of APIs, RESTful services, or software architecture concepts
• Ability to obtain and maintain a SECRET security clearance

Preferred:
• An active secret security clearance
